description: Links a LOINC laboratory test to the protein its Component-axis measurement measures or is about. Antibody tests can link to the target antigen protein; enzyme-activity tests can link to all reviewed human isoenzymes associated with that activity.

source_contributions.scope: Laboratory codes with CLASSTYPE = 1 and status ACTIVE, TRIAL, or DISCOURAGED; DEPRECATED codes are excluded. Laboratory order codes are included and may duplicate observation codes. Only existing Protein targets are represented.
source_contributions.description: Includes gene-associated protein measurements, immunohistochemistry measurements of protein products, and antibody/antigen tests. Enzyme-activity measurements include reviewed SwissProt human proteins and exclude unreviewed TrEMBL proteins. Generic enzyme names spanning multiple activities and multi-subunit protein complexes have incomplete coverage. Curated part-to-protein mappings and a curated cystatin C mapping for the cystatin C-based glomerular filtration rate test supplement identifier-based coverage. Provocation agents are excluded from analyte relationships.
